blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Materials literature contains detailed experimental knowledge, but procedures, chemical entities and measurements remain difficult to aggregate because they are reported in heterogeneous forms and depend on process-specific context. We present SciKGExtract, a schema-guided framework that combines large-language-model extraction with chemical normalization and agent-based evaluation and refinement before knowledge-graph integration. We evaluate the framework on 176 atomic-layer-deposition papers describing zinc oxide (ZnO) and indium–gallium–zinc oxide (IGZO), together with an expert-annotated full-schema subset. PubChem normalization improves exact-match extraction F1 for every tested model. For ZnO, the best F1 increases from 0.591 for direct normalized extraction to 0.805 with agentic refinement, whereas the best IGZO result is 0.344, revealing the greater difficulty of multicomponent supercycle processes. Evaluation against a deeply nested schema containing 65 experimental properties and 155 quantitative measurement nodes further exposes errors in process segmentation and numerical assignment. These results show that chemical canonicalization and targeted agentic verification provide complementary controls for converting complex materials literature into reusable, machine-actionable experimental knowledge.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Materials research depends on experimental records that connect composition, synthesis conditions, processing history and measured properties, yet much of this information remains difficult to reuse computationally because a single process may be distributed across methods, results, tables and figure descriptions; the same chemical may appear under formulas, systematic names and laboratory abbreviations; and quantitative values are meaningful only when attached to the correct process instance, quantity kind and unit. Scientific communities are therefore investing in FAIR, machine-actionable infrastructures and initiatives, including NOMAD Sbailò et al. (2022) , FAIRmat 1 1 1 https://www.fairmat-nfdi.eu/fairmat/ , the U.S. Materials Genome Initiative 2 2 2 https://www.mgi.gov/ , and NFDI-MatWerk 3 3 3 https://nfdi-matwerk.de/ . At the same time, scientific information extraction has progressed from named-entity recognition, relation extraction and coreference resolution toward direct generation of structured records. Shared tasks and systems including ScienceIE, NLPContributionGraph and SciIE established strong evaluation settings for scientific entities and relations Augenstein
et al. (2017) ; D’Souza
et al. (2021) ; Luan et al. (2018) , automatically generated scholarly knowledge graphs demonstrated the value of extraction at scale Dessì et al. (2020) , and domain-adapted models such as MatSciBERT improved text mining of materials terminology Gupta et al. (2022) . More recent work has used LLMs for hierarchical scientific information extraction Dagdelen
et al. (2024) , materials-synthesis benchmarking Yanguas-Gil
et al. (2025) , reconstruction of synthesis knowledge from materials literature Li
et al. (2026) , and large-scale materials knowledge-graph construction Bai et al. (2025) . These developments show that generative extraction can operate at scientifically useful scale, but scalable population of FAIR resources still depends on reliability when a target record contains dozens of nested properties, multiple experimental instances, quantitative measurements and chemically equivalent surface forms.

blocks.en:
Parallel to this transition in information extraction, agentic LLM architectures have established a general paradigm for iterative reasoning and self-correction. ReAct Yao et al. (2022) introduced interleaved reasoning and acting, Reflexion Shinn et al. (2023) used natural-language self-critique as a form of verbal reinforcement, and Self-Refine Madaan et al. (2023) showed that a single model can act successively as generator, critic and refiner through iterative feedback–revision cycles; related forms of iterative model interaction have since been studied in code generation Chen et al. (2024) ; Olausson
et al. (2024) , mathematical reasoning Lightman et al. (2024) ; Shao et al. (2024) and embodied agents Huang et al. (2023) . A complementary development is the use of LLMs as evaluators: G-Eval Liu et al. (2023) established rubric-based LLM evaluation, subsequent work examined agreement between strong LLM judges and human preferences Zheng et al. (2023) , and multidimensional evaluation has used explicit rating criteria for correctness, coherence and related qualities Li et al. (2024) . Their use for schema-constrained scientific information extraction and knowledge-graph population remains comparatively limited, where refinement must improve not merely the plausibility of generated text but the correctness, completeness and structural placement of machine-actionable values. SciKGExtract adopts evaluation as part of generation rather than as terminal scoring: rubric-based judges identify unsupported or missing information and convert those assessments into actionable revision instructions Hashemi et al. (2024) ; D’Souza et al. (2025) , yielding an extract → \rightarrow reflect → \rightarrow feedback → \rightarrow refine loop that operationalizes iterative refinement for deeply structured scientific records.

blocks.en:
Atomic layer deposition (ALD) provides a demanding materials-science test case for this paradigm. ALD is a surface-controlled vapor-phase deposition technique used to fabricate thin films with precise thickness and composition Kessels et al. (2025) , and a useful process record may include deposited material, precursor and co-reactant chemistry, reactor configuration, substrate, pulse and purge times, temperature windows, plasma conditions, growth-per-cycle behaviour, film composition, crystallinity and device properties. ZnO is a mature ALD system with many reported chemistries Paskaleva et al. (2022) ; Tynell and Karppinen (2014) ; Gao and Banerjee (2019) , whereas indium–gallium–zinc oxide (IGZO) is substantially more complex because deposition can combine In 2 O 3 , Ga 2 O 3 and ZnO subcycles in supercycles whose ordering and ratios determine composition and electronic properties Sheng et al. (2019) ; Mackus et al. (2019) ; Oh et al. (2025) . SciKGExtract operationalizes the agentic paradigm as a controlled, schema-guided workflow rather than a single LLM call: a semantic schema defines the admissible output structure; an extraction agent generates one or more experimental process records; selected chemical values are resolved to PubChem 4 4 4 https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/ identifiers Kim et al. (2016) ; Kim et al. (2024) ; reflection agents evaluate correctness and completeness; a feedback agent converts evaluations into revision instructions; and accepted records can be prepared for knowledge-graph integration. The framework supports direct extraction, self-refinement, multi-judge refinement and evaluator–critic debate Chan et al. (2023) ; Kim et al. (2024) . Recent work has likewise demonstrated the utility of modular LLM agents for computational materials-science tasks Chaudhari
et al. (2026) ; here, that modularity is directed specifically at quality control for literature-derived experimental knowledge, with both the scientific source document and the target schema acting as explicit constraints on generation, evaluation and revision.

blocks.en:
To evaluate SciKGExtract in a principled way, we frame the study around five questions that reflect the main methodological components of the framework and the requirements of materials-data reuse: chemical canonicalization, agentic verification, the transition from core-property extraction to deeply structured experimental reconstruction, transfer beyond the ALD domain, and practical quality–cost trade-offs. Our study is therefore organized around the following five research questions. RQ1: To what extent does PubChem-based normalization reduce chemical surface-form disagreement and improve exact extraction across models and material systems? RQ2: Which forms of agentic verification improve structured extraction, and does increasing the number or complexity of interacting agents consistently improve the result? RQ3: How does extraction performance change when the task moves from three core ALD properties to reconstruction of a deeply nested experimental process schema, and which errors become dominant? RQ4: How well does the same schema-guided orchestration transfer to scientific information-extraction tasks outside ALD when evaluated for exact structured correctness? RQ5: What quality–cost trade-offs arise across extraction models and agentic workflows, and does higher model cost correspond to higher extraction quality?
We address these questions through a 176-paper AtomicLimits evaluation [ 36 ] , an expert-annotated full-schema experiment, transfer experiments on established scientific information-extraction datasets, and measurements of model and workflow cost. Exact precision, recall and F1 are treated as the primary metrics whenever the output is intended for structured reuse because a chemically, numerically or relationally incorrect value cannot be made correct by textual resemblance alone.

blocks.en: This work makes several contributions. First, we introduce SciKGExtract, a modular agentic workflow for schema-guided scientific knowledge extraction that unifies structured extraction, chemical normalization, rubric-based evaluation and feedback-driven refinement. Second, we instantiate the workflow on ALD literature and systematically compare multiple proprietary and open-weight extraction models across direct, self-refinement, multi-judge and debate configurations, complemented by a separate controlled full-schema model sweep. Third, we present an evaluation of full-schema experimental process extraction in materials science using an expert-curated gold standard for ZnO and IGZO, thereby moving beyond shallow core-entity recovery to process segmentation, nested property assignment and quantitative reconstruction. Fourth, we demonstrate that agentic reflection and feedback can improve extraction quality while also showing that additional judges or more elaborate interaction do not guarantee better results, and we assess transfer beyond ALD together with the practical cost of alternative workflows. The documented SciKGExtract software is publicly available at https://github.com/sciknoworg/scikgextract , providing the extraction workflow, schemas, normalization components, prompts and evaluation code needed to reproduce and extend the approach.
blocks.zh: 这项工作作出了若干贡献。 首先,我们介绍SciKGExtract,这是一个用于由计划指导的科学知识提取的模块化代理工作流程,它统一了结构化提取,化学正常化,以主题为基础的评价和反馈驱动的完善. 第二,我们即时分析ALD文献的工作流程,系统地比较跨直接的,自精的,多判断的和辩论的多个专有的和开放的取材模型,并辅之以单独的可控全取材模型扫描. 三,我们提出材料科学中全程分解实验过程提取评价,采用专家精准金本位法为ZnO和IGZO取出,从而从浅层核心实体恢复到加工分解,嵌入地产分配和定量重建. 第四,我们表明,代理式的反思和反馈可以提高提取质量,同时也表明,额外的法官或更细致的互动并不能保证更好的结果,我们评估了替代工作流程的实际成本。 文件所记载的SciKGExtract软件可在https://github.com/scinoworg/scikgextract上公开查阅,提供复制和扩大该方法所需的提取工作流程、计划、正常化组件、提示和评价代码。

blocks.en: SciKGExtract operationalizes this target through the agentic workflow in Fig. 2 . The extraction agent receives the scientific article, target schema and optional examples and produces typed process records. Optional normalization attaches canonical identifiers to selected chemical values. The reflection stage evaluates extracted records against the source article and schema under correctness and completeness rubrics. When the configured acceptance criterion is not met, the feedback agent transforms judge rationales into revision instructions and the extraction is repeated. The same architecture therefore supports controlled comparisons of direct extraction, self-refinement, multiple independent judges and evaluator–critic debate without changing the target representation.

blocks.en: To address RQ1, we first evaluate three core ALD properties for which the AtomicLimits database 5 5 5 https://www.atomiclimits.com/alddatabase/ provides curated information: deposited material, precursor and co-reactant. The evaluation comprises 162 ZnO and 14 IGZO papers. Table 1 reports, for each extraction model and material, the best-performing tested refinement strategy according to normalized exact-match F1. PubChem normalization improves F1 for every model in both material systems.

blocks.en: For ZnO, Llama 3.3 70B with debate-based refinement achieves the highest result, with precision 0.780, recall 0.831 and F1 0.805. Among the remaining models, two-judge refinement produces F1 values of 0.697 for GPT-4o, 0.712 for Mistral Large, 0.719 for Gemma 4 26B and 0.673 for Ministral 3B. The normalization gain is particularly large for the smaller Ministral model, whose F1 rises from 0.473 to 0.673 in its best configuration.
blocks.zh: 对ZnO来说,Llama 3.3 70B以辩论为主的精细化实现最高的结果,精确的0.780,召回了0.831和F1 0.805. 在所余型号中,双判量精制出F1值为:GPT-4o0.697;Mistral Large0.712;Gemma 4.26B;Ministry 3B0.673. 对规模较小的部委模式而言,正常化收益特别大,其F1的最佳配置从0.473升至0.673。

blocks.en: IGZO remains much more difficult. The best normalized exact F1 is 0.344 for Llama 3.3 70B with two-judge refinement, followed by 0.334 for Ministral 3B with three judges and 0.302 for Mistral Large with three judges. Normalization nevertheless improves every configuration shown in Table 1 ; for example, the best Ministral 3B configuration increases from 0.162 to 0.334 F1. The persistence of the ZnO–IGZO performance gap after normalization shows that the remaining difficulty cannot be explained only by chemical naming variation.
blocks.zh: IGZO仍然困难得多。 Llama 3.3 70B的F1最佳常态是0.344,有2名法官改进,其次是3B部有3名法官,Mistral Large有3名法官。 尽管如此,正常化还是改善了表1所示的每个配置;例如,最好的3B部配置从0.162增加到了0.334 F1。 正常化后ZnO-IGZO性能差距持续存在,这表明剩下的困难不能仅由化学命名变化来解释.

blocks.en: Table 1: Best exact-match ALD result for each extraction model after PubChem normalization. Unnormalized F1 is shown for the same refinement configuration to isolate the effect of normalization. MJ2 and MJ3 denote multi-judge refinement with two and three judges, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:PubChem正常化后每个取出模型的最佳精确匹配ALD结果. 显示非正态的F1,用于相同的改进配置来隔离正常化的效果. MJ2和MJ3意味着多法官的完善,分别有两名和三名法官。

blocks.en: The normalization mechanism is shown in Fig. 3 . SciKGExtract preserves the extracted surface form but attempts to enrich it with PubChem identifiers Kim et al. (2024) . The lookup first uses PubChem services and a local synonym index; unresolved forms can be reformulated into alternative chemical representations and queried again. This representation allows abbreviations, formulas and systematic names to converge on a common identifier while retaining the original text for provenance.
blocks.zh: 图3显示了正常化机制。 SciKGExtract保留了取出地表形式,但试图用PubChem识别器Kim等人(2024年)来丰富它。 查取首先使用PubChem服务和本地同义词索引;未解决的表格可以被重写成替代的化学表示并再次被询问. 这种表述方式允许缩写,公式和系统名称在共同标识符上汇合而同时保留出处的原始文本.

blocks.en: Figure 3: PubChem-based normalization in SciKGExtract. Extracted chemical values are resolved through API and local lookup components, with an optional language-model disambiguation step for unresolved forms. The original extracted value is preserved and linked to resolved PubChem identifiers rather than replaced.
blocks.zh: 图3:SciKGExtract基于PubChem的正常化. 被提取的化学值通过API和本地查询组件解决,对未解表单可选择的语言模型分解步骤. 原取出值被保存并链接到已解析的PubChem标识符而不是被替换.

blocks.en: 2.3 Agentic refinement helps, but more agents are not always better
blocks.zh: 2.3 改进剂的作用,但更多的剂并不总是更好的

blocks.en: To address RQ2 and separate the effect of workflow design from model identity, we evaluate Llama 3.3 70B across the complete progression from direct extraction to self-refinement, multi-judge refinement and debate (Table 2 ). For ZnO, normalized exact-match F1 increases from 0.591 for direct extraction to 0.617 with self-refinement, 0.724 with two independent judges and 0.805 with debate. The 0.214 absolute gain from direct extraction to debate is accompanied by higher precision and recall, indicating that refinement is not simply increasing the number of extracted values.
blocks.zh: 为了解决RQ2问题并区分工作流程设计与模型身份的影响,我们评价Llama 3.3 70B在从直接提取到自精、多判断的完善和辩论的全过程(表2)。 对ZnO来说,正统的精确匹配F1从直接取出0.591增加到了0.617并自精取出,0.724加上两名独立法官,0.805加上辩论. 从直接取出到辩论的0.214绝对收益伴随着更高的精度和回想,表明精细化并不仅仅是增加取出值的数量.

blocks.en: IGZO behaves differently. Direct extraction reaches 0.277 F1 and self-refinement reaches 0.298, while two-judge refinement gives the best score of 0.344. Debate with GPT-5 as both evaluator and critic reaches 0.306; replacing the critic with DeepSeek R1 increases this to 0.331 but still does not surpass the simpler two-judge workflow. The same non-monotonic pattern occurs when moving from two to three judges for several extraction models. Additional agent interaction is therefore useful only when the resulting feedback corrects errors that matter for the target metric; it can also redirect an otherwise adequate extraction or optimize a judgment criterion that is imperfectly aligned with exact gold-standard matching.
blocks.zh: IGZO行为不同. 直接取出量达到0.277 F1并自取精度达到0.298,而双判分精度得到0.344. 与GPT-5作为评价者和评论者的辩论达到0.306;用DeepSeek R1来取而代之的是评论者,这使辩论增加到了0.331,但仍然没有超过简单的双审工作流程. 同样的非模态模式发生于几种取出模型从2名判官移到3名判官. 因此,只有当所产生的反馈纠正了对目标度量很重要的错误时,额外的代理相互作用才有用;它也可以重新定向本来适当的提取或优化判断标准,这种标准与准确的黄金标准匹配不完全一致。

blocks.en: Table 2: Effect of refinement strategy for Llama 3.3 70B after chemical normalization. Debate-self uses GPT-5 as evaluator and critic; debate-cross uses GPT-5 as evaluator and DeepSeek R1 as critic.
blocks.zh: 表2:化学品正常化后Llama 3.3 70B的改进战略的效果。 辩论自用GPT-5作为评价者和评论者;辩论自用GPT-5作为评价者和DeepSeek R1作为评论者.

blocks.en: The ZnO–IGZO contrast reflects a materials-specific increase in structural complexity rather than only a difference in entity vocabulary. A ZnO process is commonly anchored by one deposited material and a relatively regular precursor/co-reactant pair. IGZO descriptions can contain several oxide subcycles, supercycle ratios, repeated reactants and composition-dependent properties that must be associated with the correct combined process. The decline from 0.805 to 0.344 in the best exact F1 therefore quantifies the difficulty introduced by multicomponent process structure even after chemical canonicalization and agentic checking.
blocks.zh: ZnO-IGZO对比反映了结构复杂性因材料而异的增加,而不仅仅是实体词汇的差异. ZnO工艺通常由一种沉淀物和相对正常的先质/共反应物对接而成。 IGZO描述可以包含多个氧化物子循环,超循环比,重复反应剂和成份依赖性,这些特性必须与正确的结合过程相接. 因此,最精确的F1从0.805降至0.344,从而在化学罐体化和试剂检查之后,就量化了多成分工艺结构带来的困难。

blocks.en: 2.4 Expert evaluation exposes the difficulty of full experimental reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.4 (中文(简体) ). 专家评价暴露出全面实验重建的困难.

blocks.en: To address RQ3, we move beyond the three AtomicLimits fields available at scale and conduct a second, stricter experiment against expert annotations of the complete ALD schema. A domain expert annotated eight thermal-ALD ZnO process instances and five plasma-enhanced-ALD IGZO process instances from two representative papers, covering reactor conditions, reactant parameters, timing, growth characteristics, film composition and device metrics. Because many values are numerical and must be assigned to the correct process and property, the evaluation uses direct precision, recall and F1.
blocks.zh: 为了解决RQ3问题,我们超越了规模上的三个原子限制域,并对照专家对ALD全程计划的说明进行第二次更严格的试验。 一名域专家从两份有代表性的论文中注释出8个热-ALD ZnO过程实例和5个等离子增强-ALD IGZO过程实例,涉及反应堆条件,反应参数,时间,生长特征,胶片组成和装置度量. 由于许多值是数字的,必须指定正确的过程和财产,评价使用直接精确,召回和F1.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports a controlled before/after reflection experiment with GPT-4o, Mistral Large, Qwen3 30B and Qwen3 235B. For ZnO, reflection improves GPT-4o from 0.41 to 0.44 F1, Mistral Large from 0.51 to 0.53 and Qwen3 30B from 0.40 to 0.50; Qwen3 235B remains essentially unchanged. IGZO is again more difficult. Mistral Large improves from 0.20 to 0.32 and Qwen3 30B from 0.41 to 0.46, whereas GPT-4o decreases from 0.48 to 0.45 and Qwen3 235B remains at 0.29. Reflection is therefore a mechanism for correcting errors, not a guarantee of improvement.
blocks.zh: 表3汇报了GPT-4o、Mistral Large、Qune3 30B和Qune3 235B的受控反射实验。 对于ZnO,反射改进了GPT-4o从0.41到0.44 F1,Mistral Large从0.51到0.53,Qune3 30B从0.40到0.50;Qune3 235B基本上保持不变. IGZO又比较困难. Mistral大改进从0.20升至0.32;Qune3 30B从0.41升至0.46;而GPT-4o从0.48降至0.45;Qune3 235B仍为0.29。 因此,反思是一种纠正错误的机制,而不是改进的保证。

blocks.en: Table 3: Exact-match full-schema extraction on expert-annotated ALD processes before and after one reflection–feedback cycle. This experiment uses the complete 65-leaf-property target and a separate controlled model sweep from the 176-paper refinement comparison.
blocks.zh: 表3:在一次反射周期之前和之后的专家附加说明的ALD程序中精确匹配的全程提取。 这次实验使用了完整的65叶地产目标,以及从176相纸的精细比较中分离出的控制模型扫地.

blocks.en: Coverage analysis shows why the full-schema task is harder than the core-property benchmark. The expert IGZO annotations contain on average 61.8 populated properties per process, whereas one-shot model outputs contain approximately 75, indicating over-generation rather than only omission. For ZnO, the expert average is 35.5 properties compared with approximately 41 in one-shot extraction. Models also differ in process segmentation: the expert annotation contains eight ZnO process instances, whereas the tested one-shot systems recover different subsets of those processes. These results shift the dominant error mode from isolated entity recognition to process segmentation, property assignment and control of unsupported detail.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面分析显示,为什么全方案任务比核心财产基准更困难。 专家IGZO说明中平均包含每个过程的61.8个人口属性,而一发模型输出则包含约75个,表明产生过多,而不仅仅是省略. 对ZnO来说,专家平均为35.5个属性,而一发取出约41个属性. 模型在过程分解方面也不同:专家注释包含8个ZnO过程实例,而被测试的一发式系统则回收这些过程的不同子集. 这些结果将主导错误模式从孤立的实体识别转移到流程分割,财产分配和对无佐证细节的控制.

blocks.en: 2.5 Transfer experiments test portability beyond ALD
blocks.zh: 2.5 转让试验试验可移植性超出有限期间

blocks.en: To address RQ4, we exploit the fact that SciKGExtract is driven by an external schema rather than ALD-specific code and test the same orchestration on the biomedical BioRED and BC5CDR benchmarks Luo et al. (2022) ; Li et al. (2016) . These experiments are used as portability tests rather than direct state-of-the-art comparisons because training regimes, task formulations and available supervision differ across the literature. Table 4 reports the best exact-match configuration observed for each benchmark. On BioRED, Claude Sonnet 4.6 with cross-model debate reaches precision 0.3145, recall 0.2580 and exact F1 0.2834; on BC5CDR, Claude Sonnet 4.6 with two-judge refinement reaches precision 0.6985, recall 0.7542 and exact F1 0.7253. The difference between the two datasets shows that transferring the orchestration does not imply uniform task difficulty or uniform gains from the same refinement strategy, but the framework itself can be reused by changing the external schema and typed output model rather than rewriting ALD-specific extraction logic.
blocks.zh: 为了解决RQ4问题,我们利用SciKGExtract是由外部计划驱动,而不是由ALD特定代码驱动,并在生物医学BioRED和BC5CDR基准Luo等人(2022年);Li等(2016年)。 这些实验被用作可移植性测试,而不是直接进行最先进的比较,因为不同文献中的培训制度、任务安排和现有监督各不相同。 表4报告观察到的每个基准的最佳精确匹配配置。 在BioRED上,克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet) 4.6与跨型辩论达到精准度0.3145,召回0.2580和准确F1 0.2834;在BC5CDR上克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet) 4.6与双判断精准度达到0.6985,召回0.7542和准确F1 0.7253. 两个数据集的区别表明,转移管弦法并不意味着统一的任务难度或从同一种改进策略得到的统一收益,但框架本身可以通过改变外部的策略和打入输出模型来被再利用,而不是重写ALD特定的取出逻辑.

blocks.en: Table 4: Best exact-match transfer result observed on each biomedical benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表4:在每个生物医学基准上观察到的最佳准确匹配转移结果。

blocks.en: 2.6 Extraction quality is not proportional to model cost
blocks.zh: 2.6 采掘质量与模型成本不相称

blocks.en: To address RQ5, the experiment log records provider cost and token usage for every model request. Average extractor request cost in the executed runs ranges from approximately $0.00061 for Gemma 4 26B and $0.00139 for Llama 3.3 70B to $0.017 for GPT-4o and $0.020 for Claude Sonnet 4.6. Mistral Large averages approximately $0.00424 per request and Ministral 3B approximately $0.00373, the latter reflecting substantially longer prompts and completions in the logged runs. These measurements depend on provider pricing and token usage at the time of execution and are not permanent model characteristics.
blocks.zh: 为处理RQ5,每个模型请求的实验日志提供商成本和象征性使用. Gemma 4 26B和Llama 3.3 70B的平均提取器请求费用从大约0.00061美元到GPT-4o的0.017美元和Claude Sonnet的0.020美元不等。 Mistral Lige平均每项请求约0.0424美元,Ministry 3B约0.0373美元,后者反映记录运行中大为延长的提示和完成时间。 这些测量取决于执行时供应商的定价和象征性用途,不是永久性的模型特征.

blocks.en: The quality ranking is nevertheless clearly not a price ranking. Llama 3.3 70B produces the best normalized ZnO result while remaining among the lowest-cost extraction models in the experiment. Conversely, judge-heavy workflows add several model calls and can become substantially more expensive without guaranteed gains, as illustrated by IGZO. For large-scale materials extraction, the workflow should therefore be optimized as a system: a relatively inexpensive extractor combined with canonicalization and selective verification can be preferable to uniformly invoking the most expensive model.
blocks.zh: 然而,质量排名显然不是价格排名。 Llama 3.3 70B产生最佳常态ZnO结果,同时仍属于实验中成本最低的取出模型. 反之,法官繁重的工作流程增加了几个模式调用,如果不保证收益,费用就可能大大增加,正如IGZO所说明的。 因此,对于大规模取出材料,应将工作流程作为一个系统加以优化:一个相对便宜的取出器与光线化和选择性核查相结合,比统一使用最昂贵的模型更为可取。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: The experiments support a view of literature extraction as a materials data-engineering problem rather than a single-model prediction task. The schema, normalization and reflection components address distinct error sources. The semantic schema specifies what can be represented and exposes process-level structure. Chemical normalization collapses surface-form variation that would otherwise fragment equivalent materials and reactants. Agentic reflection targets unsupported, missing or structurally inconsistent content after generation. The consistent normalization gains and the more variable reflection gains show that these mechanisms are complementary rather than interchangeable.
blocks.zh: 这些实验支持将文献取出视为材料数据工程问题,而不是单一模型的预测任务. 计划、正常化和反射部分处理不同的出错源。 语义学计划规定了可以代表什么,并暴露出过程级结构. 化学正常化使表面形态的变异崩溃,否则会使等同的材料和反应剂相去甚远。 代理反射目标不支持,缺少或生成后结构不一致的内容. 持续的正常化成果和比较多变的反省成果表明,这些机制是相辅相成的,而不是可以互换的。

blocks.en:
The contribution is complementary to recent materials-language-model systems. Large-scale studies have shown that LLM-based extraction can reconstruct synthesis knowledge and populate materials knowledge graphs at substantial scale Li
et al. (2026) ; Bai et al. (2025) . Modular materials agents have also demonstrated that specialized LLM components can coordinate retrieval, simulation and structure-oriented tasks Chaudhari
et al. (2026) . SciKGExtract addresses a different bottleneck: how to quality-control a deeply structured experimental record when the schema is fixed in advance and correct population depends on process segmentation, quantitative property assignment and chemical canonicalization. The experiments therefore test not only whether an LLM can generate plausible structured text, but whether the resulting records remain usable as interoperable materials knowledge.
blocks.zh:
这一贡献是对近期材料语言模型系统的补充。 大规模的研究表明,以LLM为原料的取出可以重建合成知识,并大量地将材料知识图分解为李.
et al. (2026).; Bai等 (2025). 模块材料剂也证明,专门的LLM组件可以协调检索、模拟和结构导向的任务Chaudhari
等 (2026) (中文(简体) ). SciKGExtract解决了一个不同的瓶颈:当计划事先固定并且正确的人口数量取决于过程分解,定量属性分配和化学犬类化时,如何质量控制一个结构严密的实验记录. 因此,这些实验不仅检验LLM是否能够产生合理结构的文本,而且检验所产生的记录是否仍可作为可互操作的材料知识使用。

blocks.en: Chemical canonicalization is particularly important for materials knowledge bases because cross-paper reuse depends on identity, not only textual similarity. The core ALD results show that a model can identify the correct chemistry conceptually while still fail exact matching because the paper and gold standard use different names or formulas. Resolving those forms to PubChem identifiers substantially improves agreement across every tested extraction model. This suggests that identifier linking should be integrated into extraction workflows rather than postponed to a separate database-cleaning stage.
blocks.zh: 化学卡通化对于材料知识基础特别重要,因为跨纸再用取决于身份,而不仅仅是文字相似性. 核心ALD结果显示,一个模型可以在概念上识别出正确的化学,而同时又未能精确匹配,因为纸张和金本位使用不同的名称或公式. 将这些表格溶入PubChem识别器可大大地改善每个测试取出模型的一致。 这表明应把标识符链接纳入提取工作流程,而不是推迟到单独的数据库清理阶段。

blocks.en: Agentic verification has a different profile. For ZnO, Llama 3.3 70B improves steadily from direct extraction through self-refinement, multi-judge refinement and debate. For IGZO, the best result is obtained with the simpler two-judge workflow, while additional debate does not improve F1. The full-schema experiment is similarly mixed: several models improve after one reflection cycle, one remains unchanged and one loses accuracy on IGZO. These findings qualify a central assumption of iterative-refinement paradigms: feedback can improve a candidate output, but additional agents or additional interaction are not themselves evidence of greater reliability. In schema-constrained scientific extraction, the value of reflection depends on whether an evaluator identifies a correctable error and produces feedback that is aligned with exact structured correctness, process identity and property assignment.
blocks.zh: 代理验证有不同的配置. 对ZnO来说,Llama 3.3 70B通过自取精炼,多判断精炼和辩论,从直接取出稳步改善. 对于IGZO来说,最好的结果是采用更简单的双法官工作流程,而额外的辩论并不能改进F1. 完全-schema实验同样有好有坏:几个模型在一个反射周期后有所改善,一个模型保持不变,一个模型在IGZO上失去精度. 这些结论对迭代精细范式的中央假设具有限定性:反馈可以改善候选输出,但额外的代理或额外的交互本身并不证明可靠性更高. 在受计划约束的科学取出中,反射值取决于评价者是否识别出可纠正的错误并产生与准确的结构正确性,过程身份和财产分配相一致的反馈.

blocks.en: The ZnO–IGZO gap is scientifically informative because it identifies process complexity as a major determinant of extraction performance. IGZO combines multiple oxide subcycles, supercycle ratios and composition-dependent measurements. Correct extraction therefore requires long-range document interpretation and assignment of properties to the appropriate process instance. Even after chemical normalization, the best exact F1 remains 0.344, providing a stringent measure of the difficulty of multicomponent process reconstruction and a more realistic benchmark for systems intended to populate materials databases.
blocks.zh: ZnO-IGZO差距具有科学信息性,因为它将过程的复杂性确定为提取性能的主要决定因素. IGZO结合了多氧化物子循环,超循环比和依赖成分的测量. 因此,正确提取需要长距离文件解释,并将属性分配给适当的流程。 即使在化学品正常化之后,最精确的F1仍为0.344,为多种成分过程重建的困难提供了严格的衡量标准,并为旨在填充材料数据库的系统提供了更现实的基准。

blocks.en: The expert full-schema evaluation further shows that success on material, precursor and co-reactant fields does not imply successful reconstruction of an experiment. The principal difficulties become segmentation of multiple processes, hierarchical alignment of nested properties, and assignment of dense numerical information. The expert annotation also revealed an additional ZnO process only after visual information was considered, emphasizing that complete materials extraction is inherently multimodal. The present study is text-centred; integrating tables, plots, schematics and image-derived evidence is a necessary next step.
blocks.zh: 专家的全面评价进一步表明,在材料、前体和共同反应领域取得成功并不意味着成功重建实验。 主要困难是多个过程的分化、巢系特性的分级调整和密集数字信息的指定。 专家的注释还表明,只有在考虑视觉信息之后,ZnO进程才增加,强调完整的材料取出本质上是多式的。 本研究以文字为中心;整合表格、地图、图表和图像证据是下一步的必要步骤。

blocks.en: The study has several limitations. The deep-schema gold standard covers two representative papers and thirteen text-derived process instances, although each instance contains many property–value decisions. Expanding expert annotation across more materials and deposition chemistries would support stronger variance estimates and property-level error analysis. The transfer experiments demonstrate portability of the orchestration but are not intended as state-of-the-art benchmark claims. Model APIs, model versions and provider pricing also change rapidly, so the cost analysis should be interpreted as a measurement of the executed configurations rather than a permanent ranking.
blocks.zh: 该研究有若干局限性。 深层金本位标准涵盖两份有代表性的文件和13个文本衍生过程实例,尽管每个实例都包含许多财产价值决定。 扩大专家对更多材料和沉积化学的说明,将有助于更有力的差异估计和地产级误差分析。 转让试验表明,管弦乐的可移动性,但并非作为最新基准索赔。 模型API,模型版本和供应商定价也迅速变化,因此成本分析应该被解释为对被执行配置的衡量,而不是永久性的排名.

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, the results establish practical principles for materials-literature extraction. Exact structured evaluation should be the primary basis for assessing outputs intended for machine-actionable reuse, canonical identifiers should be incorporated into the extraction pipeline, and deep-schema evaluation should measure process identity and property assignment rather than entity presence alone. Embedding-based similarity measures can still be useful as diagnostics, but they require careful implementation and interpretation for numerical and identifier-bearing records because proximity in an embedding space does not establish scientific equivalence between quantities, identifiers or process assignments. Agentic verification should likewise be used selectively and evaluated empirically rather than assumed to improve with additional judges. Together, these principles make extracted records more suitable for interoperable materials knowledge bases and provide a foundation for downstream comparison, retrieval and reasoning over experimental literature.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些限制,结果为取出材料识字确立了实用原则。 确切的结构化评价应作为评估用于机器可操作再利用的产出的主要基础,应把犬类识别剂纳入开采管道,而深层评价应衡量流程身份和财产分配,而不是仅衡量实体的存在。 基于嵌入的类似性措施仍然可以用作诊断,但它们需要认真执行和解释数字和有识别特征的记录,因为嵌入空间的相近性不能确定数量、识别特征或处理任务之间的科学等同性。 同样,应该有选择地使用代理核查,从经验上加以评价,而不是假定在增加法官后会有所改善。 这些原则加在一起,使取出的记录更适合互操作材料知识库,为下游比较,检索和推理而不是实验文献提供了基础.

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: 4.1 SciKGExtract architecture
blocks.zh: 4.1 SciKGExtract 架构

blocks.en: SciKGExtract is implemented as a modular sequential workflow coordinated by an orchestrator, with the overall control flow summarized in Fig. 2 . Four task-specific components are used: Extract & Normalize, Reflect, Feedback and KG Integration. The orchestrator maintains the shared state, including the scientific article, target schema, typed output model, model configuration, candidate extraction, normalization status, evaluation results and feedback. The same underlying orchestration is used throughout the experiments; the tested refinement strategies differ primarily in how the evaluation and feedback stages are configured rather than in the extraction target or overall processing pipeline.
blocks.zh: SciKGExtract是作为一个由管弦乐团协调的模块相继工作流程执行的,总体控制流汇总于Fig. 2 (中文(简体) ). 使用了四个特定任务组件:取出并规范化,反射,反馈和KG集成. 管弦乐团维持了共享状态,包括科学文章,目标计划,打出输出模型,模型配置,候选取出,正常化状态,评价结果和反馈. 在整个试验过程中都采用了同样的基本安排;经过测试的完善战略主要在评价和反馈阶段的配置方面有所不同,而不是在提取目标或整体加工管道方面。

blocks.en: The Extract & Normalize component prompts an LLM to generate one or more structured process instances that conform to the supplied schema. The schema is treated as authoritative for property names, value types, nesting and cardinality constraints, while optional few-shot examples provide domain-specific demonstrations of how textual evidence should be mapped into that structure. Outputs are parsed through typed data models and can be checked by a JSON-schema validator, after which cleaning removes residual null values and empty structures. When normalization is enabled, selected structured values are enriched with external identifiers before they proceed to subsequent evaluation. This arrangement separates generation, structural validation and canonicalization while keeping them within a single extraction stage.
blocks.zh: 提取和规范化组件会提示 LLM 生成一个或多个符合所提供方案的结构化进程实例 。 计划被视为财产名称、价值类型、筑巢和主要限制的权威,而可选的几发实例则提供了具体领域演示,说明应如何将文字证据映入这一结构。 输出通过打入的数据模型解析,可以通过JSON-schema验证器来检查,之后清除剩余无效值和空结构. 实现正常化后,在进行后续评价之前,选定的结构化数值会用外部识别符来丰富。 这种安排将生成,结构验证和犬科化分开,同时将它们保存在一个取出阶段.

blocks.en: The Reflect component evaluates each extracted process against both the scientific source and the target schema using correctness and completeness as the primary rubrics. Correctness captures unsupported values, incorrect units and schema inconsistencies, whereas completeness captures omitted process instances or missing information required to reconstruct the reported experiment. Rubric-based evaluation follows the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm Liu et al. (2023) ; D’Souza et al. (2025) . Depending on the experimental setting, this stage is instantiated using a single evaluator, multiple independent judges, or an evaluator–critic configuration. The Feedback component converts judge ratings and rationales into revision instructions that are returned to the extractor when refinement is required. The feedback loop shown in Fig. 2 therefore represents an actual execution path in the system: candidate records can be revised and re-evaluated before being accepted rather than merely scored once.
blocks.zh: 反射部分以正确性和完整性作为主要标点,对照科学来源和目标计划评价每个提取过程。 正确性捕捉不支持的值,不正确的单位和计划不一致,而完整性捕捉省略了重建所报告实验所需的处理实例或缺失信息. 基于Rubric的评价遵循LLM-as-a-judge的范式Liu等人(2023年);D'Souza等人(2025年). 视实验环境而定,这一阶段采用单一评价员、多个独立法官或评价员-批评员配置进行即时化。 反馈部分将评分和理由转换为修订指示,在需要改进时将订正指示退回提取器。 因此,图2所示的反馈回路代表了系统的一个实际执行路径:在被接受之前,可以修改和重新评价候选人的记录,而不仅仅是得分一次.

blocks.en: The KG Integration component transforms accepted process records into graph-oriented representations suitable for resources such as the Open Research Knowledge Graph Auer et al. (2025) . This final stage is deliberately separated from extraction and quality control so that only records that have passed the configured validation, normalization and reflection steps are prepared for downstream graph integration. The architecture is configuration-driven, allowing extraction, validation, normalization, cleaning and reflection to be enabled independently and model providers to be changed without altering the target schema.
blocks.zh: KG集成部分将被接受的流程记录转换为适合资源的面向图表的表示,如"开放研究知识图Auer等" (2025). 这个最后阶段被有意地从取出和质量控制中分离出来,以便只有经过所配置的验证,正常化和反射步骤的记录才能被准备出下游图集成. 架构由配置驱动,可以独立启用取出,验证,正常化,清洁和反射,并可以改变模型提供者而无需改变目标方案.

blocks.en: 4.2 ALD schema and task representation
blocks.zh: 4.2 限期任用办法和任务说明

blocks.en:
The ALD extraction target is derived from an expert-validated semantic model for experimental ALD knowledge Sadruddin
et al. (2025a) ; Sadruddin
et al. (2025b) , a partial view of which is shown in Fig. 1 . One ALD process is represented as the lead resource and is connected to nested descriptions of the deposition system, reactant selection, process parameters, material properties, device properties and additional experimental information. The complete programmatic target extends substantially beyond the portion visible in the figure and contains 65 leaf properties. Quantitative measurements are represented using QUDT-grounded quantity structures FAIRsharing.org (2025) , yielding 155 quantity nodes when the schema is expanded.
blocks.zh:
ALD提取目标来源于实验性ALD知识Sadruddin的专家验证语义模型
等人(2025a);萨德鲁丁
等 (2025b),其部分视图以Fig来显示. 1 (英语). 一个ALD过程作为主导资源被代表,与嵌入式的沉积系统描述,反应物选择,过程参数,材料属性,设备属性和额外的实验信息相接. 完整的方案目标远远超出了图中可见的部分,包含65个叶子特性. 定量测量使用QUDT基于量结构FAIRSEY.org(2025)表示,在扩大计划时产生155个量节点.

blocks.en: This hierarchical representation directly defines the extraction task. The model is not asked to generate an unconstrained textual summary of an experiment, but to instantiate one or more process resources whose properties, nesting and value types conform to the predefined schema. Consequently, an extracted value can be textually correct but structurally incorrect if it is attached to the wrong process instance or placed under the wrong schema branch. A deposition temperature, for example, must be associated with the appropriate process-parameter structure, whereas a mobility measurement belongs to the device-properties branch of the corresponding process. The branching visible in Fig. 1 therefore reflects part of the structural reasoning required during extraction in addition to recognizing materials, chemicals and numerical values.
blocks.zh: 这种分级代表制直接定义了提取任务. 该模型不是要生成一个实验的不受约束的文字摘要,而是要即时开发一个或多个其属性,筑巢和值类型符合被预定义的图案的处理资源. 因此,所提取的值如果附在错误的处理实例上或置于错误的系统分支下,则在文字上是正确的,但在结构上是不正确的。 例如,沉降温度必须与适当的工艺参数结构相挂钩,而机动性测量则属于相应工艺的装置-财产分支。 因此,图1中可见的分支部分反映了除识别材料、化学品和数值外,在提取过程中所需的结构推理。

blocks.en: For each document, the extraction target consists of one or more process resources that must satisfy both the evidence contained in the source article and the structural constraints encoded by the schema. The schema is supplied to the LLM in JSON form and mirrored by typed data models used to parse and validate generated records. The same representation underlies the expert full-schema experiment, so the difficulty measured there arises from reconstructing a complete hierarchical experimental record rather than recovering an isolated set of entities or relations.
blocks.zh: 对于每个文档,取出目标由一个或多个过程资源组成,必须既能满足源文章中包含的证据,又能满足由计划所编码的结构约束. schema以JSON形式提供给LLM,并被用于分解和验证所生成记录的打入数据模型镜像. 同样的表述是专家全程实验的基础,因此衡量的困难来自重建完整的分级实验记录,而不是恢复一组孤立的实体或关系。

blocks.en: 4.3 ALD literature corpus
blocks.zh: 4.3 ALD文献汇编

blocks.en:
The principal model/refinement comparison uses papers linked from the AtomicLimits ALD Database [ 36 ] . AtomicLimits provides manually curated deposited-material and reactant information compiled from the ALD literature and major review articles Puurunen (2005) ; Miikkulainen
et al. (2013) ; Mackus et al. (2018) ; Knoops et al. (2019) . We use 162 ZnO papers and 14 IGZO papers, for a total of 176 papers in the core-property evaluation.
blocks.zh:
主要模型/精炼比较使用与原子Limits ALD数据库相连接的纸 [36]. Atomimits提供从ALD文献和主要评论文章Puurunen(2005年)中汇编的人工储存材料和反应信息; Miikkulainen
等人(2013年);Mackus等人(2018年);Knoops等人(2019年)。 我们使用了162个ZnO论文和14个IGZO论文,在核心财产评价中总共使用了176个论文.

blocks.en: ZnO represents a mature binary-oxide deposition system with many reported chemistries. IGZO represents a multicomponent oxide for which deposition descriptions can contain several subcycles and supercycle ratios Sheng et al. (2019) ; Mackus et al. (2019) ; Oh et al. (2025) . PDFs are converted to machine-readable text and tables with Docling Auer et al. (2024) and stored as Markdown before being passed to SciKGExtract.
blocks.zh: ZnO代表一个成熟的二氧化物沉积系统,有许多报道的化学. IGZO代表一种多成份氧化物,其沉积描述可以包含多个子循环和超循环比. Sheng等 (2019年); Mackus等 (2019年); Oh等 (2025年). PDF被转换为机器可读文本和表格,配有Docling Auer等 (2024)并被存储为Markdown后再被传递到SciKGExtract.

blocks.en: 4.4 Chemical normalization
blocks.zh: 4.4 化学品正常化

blocks.en: Selected chemical properties are normalized to PubChem Kim et al. (2024) using the resolution procedure summarized in Fig. 3 . Normalization is applied to extracted chemical values so that chemically equivalent surface forms can be associated with a common external identifier while the representation used in the source article remains available for provenance. This distinction is important in the ALD literature, where the same material, precursor or co-reactant may be expressed using systematic names, molecular formulas, abbreviations or author-specific variants.
blocks.zh: 利用Fig所总结的解析程序,将选定的化学特性正常化为PubChem Kim等人(2024年)。 3,将正态化应用于所提取的化学值,以便化学等同表面形式可与共同的外部标识符相联,而源文章中使用的表示可用作出处. 这种区分在ALD文献中很重要,在文献中,可以使用系统名称,分子公式,缩写或作者特有变体来表示同一种材料,前体或同反应物.

blocks.en: The normalizer first standardizes the extracted surface form and queries the available PubChem lookup components. A cache and local synonym index provide efficient resolution and fallback for forms that are not resolved directly. When enabled, an LLM-based disambiguation step can generate an alternative chemical representation, such as a corrected name, molecular formula or InChI, which is then submitted again to the lookup procedure. As indicated by the fallback sequence in Fig. 3 , deterministic lookup is attempted before generative reformulation, so the language model is used only when the available identifier resources do not resolve the original form.
blocks.zh: 常态化器首先将取取的表层格式标准化,并查询可用的PubChem检索组件. 缓存和本地同义索引为未直接解决的表格提供了高效的解析和倒置. 启用时,基于LLM的分解步骤可以产生一种替代的化学代表,如校正名称,分子式或InChi,然后再次被提交到查询程序. 如Fig. 3中的倒置序列所显示,在基因再造之前尝试了确定性的取向,因此语言模型只有在可用的标识资源不能解决原始形式时才被使用.

blocks.en: Successfully resolved values retain the original extracted string and are enriched with the corresponding external identifier rather than being replaced by a canonical text label. The normalization step therefore addresses a specific class of evaluation disagreement: two strings may denote the same chemical entity but fail exact matching because they use different surface forms. By resolving such variants before structured evaluation, the workflow separates chemical naming variation from more substantive extraction errors such as selecting the wrong reactant, associating it with the wrong process, or omitting it entirely.
blocks.zh: 被成功解析的值保留了被提取的原始字符串并被相应的外部标识符所丰富,而不是被取而代之的犬形文字标签所取代. 因此,正常化步骤解决了特定类别的评价分歧:两个字符串可能表示同一个化学实体,但因使用不同的表面形式而未能准确匹配。 通过在结构化评价前解决这些变体,工作流程将化学命名变体与更实质性的取出错误区分开来,如选择错误的反应物,将其与错误的过程联系起来,或者完全省略.

blocks.en: 4.5 Refinement strategies and models
blocks.zh: 4.5 完善战略和模式

blocks.en: Four workflow settings are evaluated. Direct extraction performs one schema-guided extraction pass without reflection. Self-refinement uses a single model family for generation, evaluation and feedback. Multi-judge refinement uses independent judge models whose assessments are consolidated before feedback. Debate refinement introduces evaluator–critic pairs in which the critic can challenge an initial evaluation before feedback is produced Chan et al. (2023) ; Kim et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 对四个工作流程设置进行评价。 直接取出一次没有反射的有计划制导取出通道。 自修采用单一的模范家族进行生成,评价和反馈. 多法官完善采用独立法官模式,其评估在反馈前得到综合。 辩论的完善引入了评价者-批评者对一对,其中批评者可以在产生反馈前对初步评价提出质疑 Chan等人(2023);Kim等人(2024)。

blocks.en: The 176-paper ALD comparison evaluates GPT-4o, Llama 3.3 70B, Mistral Large, Gemma 4 26B and Ministral 3B as extraction models. In the two-judge setting, GPT-5 and DeepSeek R1 act as judges and GPT-4o summarizes their assessments. The three-judge setting adds Qwen3 30B Thinking. Debate experiments use GPT-5 as evaluator with either GPT-5 or DeepSeek R1 as critic. Claude Sonnet 4.6 is additionally used in the transfer experiments.
blocks.zh: 176相纸ALD比较评价了GPT-4o,Llama3.3 70B,Mistral Large,Gemma 4 26B和Ministry 3B作为提取模型. 在两名法官的环境下,GPT-5和DeepSeek R1担任法官,GPT-4o总结其评估。 三位法官的设定增加了Quen3 30B 发想. 辩论实验使用GPT-5作为评价者,GPT-5或DeepSeek R1作为评论者. Claude Sonnet 4.6在转移实验中被额外使用.

blocks.en: The full-schema expert experiment is a separate controlled model sweep using GPT-4o, Mistral Large, Qwen3 30B and Qwen3 235B Yang et al. (2024) . Its purpose is to measure reconstruction of the complete 65-leaf-property schema rather than to rank the newer model set. Results from the two experiment families are therefore reported separately.
blocks.zh: Full-schema专家实验是使用GPT-4o,Mistral Large,Qune3 30B和Qune3 235B进行单独控制型号扫描. 杨等 (2024). 其宗旨是衡量完整的65叶地产计划重建,而不是对更新型的模式进行排序. 因此,两个试验家庭的结果分别报告。

blocks.en: 4.6 Expert full-schema annotation
blocks.zh: 4.6 (中文(简体) ). 专家全文说明

blocks.en: Two representative ALD studies, one describing ZnO and one describing IGZO, were annotated by a PhD researcher with ALD expertise. The text-based gold standard contains eight thermal-ALD ZnO process instances and five plasma-enhanced-ALD IGZO process instances. Annotation covers reactor conditions, reactant parameters, cycle structure, growth characteristics, composition and device properties. The annotation process included iterative guideline refinement and consistency checking. Inspection of figures identified an additional ZnO process; because the experiments reported here are text-based, that image-derived process is not included in the text-only evaluation. The released annotations are available through the SciKGExtract repository.
blocks.zh: 具有ALD专门知识的博士研究员对两项具有代表性的ALD研究作了说明,一项是描述ZnO,另一项是描述IGZO。 基于文本的金本位包含有8个热-ALD ZnO进程实例和5个等离子增强-ALD IGZO进程实例. 注释涵盖反应堆条件,反应参数,循环结构,生长特征,组成和装置属性等. 注释过程包括反复修订准则和核对一致性。 对数字的检查确定了另一个ZnO过程;因为这里报告的实验是基于文本的,所以图像生成过程不包含在文本评价中. 发布后的说明可通过SciKGExtract寄存器提供.

blocks.en: 4.7 Transfer benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.7 转让基准

blocks.en: BioRED is a document-level biomedical relation-extraction dataset with multiple biomedical entity and relation types Luo et al. (2022) . BC5CDR contains chemical and disease entities together with document-level chemical–disease relations Li et al. (2016) . For each dataset, the target schema and typed output model are changed while the SciKGExtract orchestration remains the same. The experiments are used to assess framework portability rather than to claim direct state-of-the-art performance against systems trained under different assumptions.
blocks.zh: BioRED是一款具有多个生物医学实体和关系类型Luo等(2022)的文档级生物医学关系采集数据集. BC5CDR包含化学和疾病实体以及文件级的化学-疾病关系Li等(2016年)。 对于每个数据集,目标计和打出输出模型都会被改变而SciKGExtract管弦乐则保持不变. 这些实验用于评估框架可移植性,而不是针对根据不同假设培训的系统声称直接的先进性能。

blocks.en: 4.8 Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 4.8 评价尺度

blocks.en: Exact precision, recall and F1 are the primary extraction metrics. A predicted item counts as correct only when it matches the corresponding gold-standard representation under the evaluation normalization rules, and accuracy is additionally reported for the normalized ALD experiments as recorded in the experiment log. We do not use embedding-based similarity measures as the basis for the conclusions reported here. Such measures can be informative as secondary diagnostics, but their implementation requires particular care for numerical values, chemical identifiers and other structured fields: two serialized values can be close in an embedding space without being scientifically equivalent, and numerical conflation can therefore produce apparently high similarity that has no valid interpretation for structured extraction. Exact agreement is consequently used wherever correctness of the recovered entity, relation, identifier or quantity is the relevant criterion.
blocks.zh: 精确的精度,回想和F1是主要的取出指标. 只有在符合评价正常化规则下的相应金标准表述时,预测的物项才算正确,另外还报告了试验日志所记录的标准化有限期间试验的准确性。 我们不以嵌入式相似性计量作为本文所报告结论的基础。 这些措施作为二级诊断可以提供信息,但其实施需要特别注意数值、化学识别符和其他结构化领域:两个序列化的数值可以在一个嵌入空间中相接而无科学等同,因此数字混和可以产生明显高度的相似性,对结构化取出没有有效的解释. 因此,只要被追回实体的正确性、关系、身份识别或数量是相关标准,就使用精确协议。

blocks.en: 4.9 Cost measurements
blocks.zh: 4.9 (中文(简体) ). 成本计量

blocks.en: The experiment log records per-request cost and input/output token counts under the provider pricing used when the experiments were executed. Reported costs are averages over the logged requests for a model. They characterize quality–cost trade-offs in the tested workflows and should not be interpreted as fixed price estimates because provider pricing and token usage vary over time.
blocks.zh: 试验日志记录了每项要求的费用和输入/输出的代号,根据执行试验时使用的供应商定价进行计算。 报告的费用是记录的模型申请的平均数。 它们将经过测试的工作流程中的质量-成本取舍定性,不应解释为固定价格估计数,因为供应商定价和象征性用途随时间而异。

blocks.en: 4.10 Use of generative AI in manuscript preparation
blocks.zh: 4.10 (中文(简体) ). 手稿编写中使用基因AI

blocks.en: Generative AI tools were used to support language editing, phrasing and clarity during preparation of the manuscript. The authors reviewed and validated the resulting text and remain responsible for the scientific content.
blocks.zh: 在编写手稿时,使用了通用的AI工具来支持语言编辑、措辞和清晰度。 作者们审查并验证了由此产生的案文,并继续对科学内容负责。

blocks.en: Data availability

blocks.en: The AtomicLimits source dataset is publicly available through the AtomicLimits ALD Database [ 36 ] . The expert gold-standard annotations used for the full-schema evaluation are available in the SciKGExtract repository at https://github.com/sciknoworg/scikgextract/tree/main/data/gold-standard-annotations .
blocks.zh: Atomimits源数据集通过Atomimits ALD数据库公开提供 [36]. 用于全面评价的专家金标准说明可在SciKGExtract存储库查阅,网址是:https://github.com/scineworg/scikgextract/tree/main/data/gold-standard-annodations 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Code availability
blocks.zh: 代码可用性

blocks.en: SciKGExtract is available as open-source software at https://github.com/sciknoworg/scikgextract . The archived software release is available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19714379 . The repository contains the extraction workflow, normalization components, schemas, prompts, evaluation code and runnable examples.
blocks.zh: SciKGExtract作为开源软件可在https://github.com/scinoworg/scikgextract上查阅。 存档软件发布可在https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19714379查阅 。 。 。 。 该寄存器包含提取工作流程,正常化组件,计划,提示,评价代码和可运行的例子.
